title: Spin
author: Robert Charles Wilson
review: Really good character-forward sci-fi and has a lot of good ideas that progressively build upon each other and come together in a satisfying way. Enjoyed the writing style as well, I'll be checking out more from this author in the future. I did feel pretty satisfied with the ending and there's more books in this universe so we'll see if I continue this or check out something new by him.
